rule.text:
Up to two courses may be taken outside of the department, including courses transferred from a prior institution, pre-approved extra-departmental electives, and study abroad courses. Contact the Film & Media advisor for approval.
Note that students may take any of FILM 125, 135, 145, or 155 more than once, with any subsequent course counting as an upper division elective as long as the course topic has
changed.
No more than 4 units from each of the following courses are allowed: FILM 197A, 197B, and 197C
A minimum grade of C- is required.
